answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities: each new identity pays 5 tokens, non-refundable. Honest agents pay once; repeat registrations climb a terrace schedule, 10 for the second and 20 for the third in one epoch. At demand zenith the tax doubles. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 5 = 5,000 tokens, while one honest agent pays 5 and earns undiluted rewards. Falcon audits sample traders; an identity with no real trades loses its tax.
